self.release_admission()
        self.restart_triggers()
        self.phase("restarted", triggers=self.final_triggers)

        health = self.check_health()
evidence.reason: The deploy releases admission at line 770 before restarting triggers (771) and before its health check (774-778). If the process dies in that window, the switched host has no admission marker or hold recorded, and the only unfinished-transaction guard is called before the switch (755). A later controller switch or runbook deploy can acquire the freed hold and proceed without knowing that health never completed. This is a crash-safety defect in the intended deploy flow, and the proposed pending-deploy record is the smallest compatible fix.
